tools.name: shipping_oil_trade
tools.description: Query bilateral oil trade flows (EIA US imports/exports + Eurostat). Accepts structured filters OR a free-text `query` (matches country/notes). NOTE: this is import/export flow data, NOT chokepoint throughput — for Hormuz transit volumes use shipping_chokepoint.

tools.name: shipping_fleet
tools.description: Query tanker fleet database. Accepts structured filters OR a free-text `query` (matches vessel name, IMO, owner, or type).

tools.name: shipping_status
tools.description: Database statistics plus per-dataset freshness: how recently each dataset was refreshed by our pipeline, how old its newest record is, and whether it is ok / lagging / stale / empty. Call this to decide how much to trust anything else this server returns.

tools.name: shipping_freshness
tools.description: Per-dataset freshness only: pipeline refresh age vs expected cadence, newest record age, source, and status (ok / lagging / stale / empty / unknown). Use before relying on a figure that must be current.

tools.name: shipping_top_exporters
tools.description: Top oil exporting countries by value/volume (a ranking — no query needed). Optional `product` or `query` recognizes a product keyword (crude/refined/lng/coal/iron_ore).

tools.name: shipping_country_flows
tools.description: Trade partners for a specific country (who they export to / import from). Pass the country as `country` or `query`.

tools.name: shipping_emissions
tools.description: Query EU MRV vessel emissions data — CO2, fuel consumption, time at sea for 22,543 vessels (2018-2024). Search by IMO, ship type, or year — or a free-text `query` (7-digit = IMO, else ship type/name).

tools.name: shipping_sanctioned_at_eu
tools.description: Find sanctioned vessels that called at EU/EEA ports. Cross-references OFAC sanctions with EU MRV emissions data (verifiable IMO-level identity). Filter by year or a free-text `query` (sanctions program e.g. "Iran"/"Russia", flag, or vessel name).

tools.name: shipping_chokepoint
tools.description: Maritime chokepoint intelligence for Hormuz, Suez, Malacca, or Bab el-Mandeb. Returns authoritative EIA baseline throughput (barrels/day, % of global), a live AIS snapshot (vessels/tankers/moving/stationary) for the chokepoint, sanctioned vessels currently detected there, and dark-fleet behavioural

tools.name: shipping_port
tools.description: What this service holds about ONE port, and how good the evidence is. Returns NGA World Port Index identity (UN/LOCODE, coordinates, harbour class, channel/anchorage/pier depths), the evidence grade for our movement data (origin = the authority publishes its own board / custody = a third party publi

tools.name: shipping_port_calls
tools.description: Berth-level vessel movements harvested from port authority movement boards: vessel, IMO, arrival/departure, berth, agent, declared last/next port. Each row carries its source and whether the channel was TLS-verified. This is TESTIMONY from the port, distinct from the AIS-inferred port_visits behind

tools.name: shipping_port_coverage
tools.description: Coverage ledger across all 2,951 ports: how many we hold at each evidence grade, how many publish a machine-readable movement board, and what happened when we checked those that do not. Call this to find out what this service does NOT know about ports before relying on what it does.

tools.name: shipping_doc_intel
tools.description: Query the shipping document intelligence layer: eBL platform adoption (12 platforms), MLETR country adoption (23 countries, 13 enacted), document fraud cases ($11.3B), DCSA standards (10), industry stats (26 metrics). The state of shipping document digitization.
